output.one_liner: Airtable's structured field types, relational links, and built-in automations make it a rich data layer for AI agents.

auth.notes: OAuth recommended for end-user connections; Personal Access Tokens (PATs) recommended for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups, transmitted as Bearer authorization header.

evidence.snippet: OAuth (recommended for end-user connections) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs, recommended for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups).

access.notes: Pages state 'The server is available to all users on all plans' but do not describe account creation, free tier availability, sign-up process, or whether Airtable requires payment.

evidence.snippet: The server is available to all users on all plans.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 5 requests per second per base documented for record operations; full rate-limit scope not detailed.

evidence.snippet: Rate limit: 5 requests per second per base.
Airtable's MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases.
point it at the Airtable MCP server URL: https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp

buildability.rationale: Composio has already built and deployed a 28-tool Airtable toolkit with OAuth and bearer token authentication; broad API coverage documented.

overview_evidence.snippet: Airtable's structured field types, relational links, and built-in automations make it a rich data layer for AI agents.
Airtable is model agnostic and works with the AI tools your team already use.

unknown_reasons.access: Pages state API is 'available to all users on all plans' but do not describe account creation, free tier existence, or whether payment is required to obtain credentials.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI specification not mentioned; webhook API support not explicitly documented in provided pages.
